newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT FIRMS VS DOLLAR, BCE MARK MOST ACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: FORINT FIRMS VS DOLLAR, BCE MARK MOST ACTIVE.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed the Tuesday session of the interbank forex market firmer against the dollar as it followed movements on international markets, dealers said.
The forint closed at 155.03/08 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155.23/28.
"The forint followed the dollar/mark cross throughout the day" said Gabriella Szirtes of Budapest Bank, adding that the Hungarian unit traded right on the central bank's resistance level (bid).
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), German mark and Swiss frank futures were the main movers.
The mark rose for three maturities and finished lower for one, while the Swiss frank dropped for three maturities.
Japanese yen futures attracted 4,390 contracts out of a total 9,497 contracts tunrover of the currency section.
